maddeler.e:
استرسلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَرْسَلُوا (istarsalū) /is.tar.sa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَرْسَلَ (istarsala)
# اُسْتُرْسِلُوا (ustursilū) /us.tur.si.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْسَلَ (istarsala)
# اِسْتَرْسِلُوا (istarsilū) /is.tar.si.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْسَلَ (istarsala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
